name: 01-precision-desk
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity desktop application interface concept for Adelpha, a premium engineering application for STEP CAD magnet assembly FEM simulation with Gmsh and Elmer. Landscape 16:10 presentation, crisp polished UI, straight-on screenshot only, no laptop/device frame, no perspective. This is a design concept, not real solver output. Use consistent small readable typography, restrained spacing, precise thin icons, professional scientific visualization, generous model space. Show a completed simulation of two cuboid permanent magnets vertically separated by a gap, colored by magnetic flux density, with a clean scientific blue-teal-yellow scale in tesla. Keep controls out of the model's focal area. Essential actual features: STEP import and solid/material assignment, mesh sizes, Run simulation, CAD/Mesh/Results views, B/H/A fields and magnitude/XYZ components, surface/cross-section mode, plane position, air and mesh edges, point values, PNG export, downloadable results. Show only controls relevant to the displayed results stage; setup can live in tabs or collapsed sections. No fanciful holograms, no marketing landing page, no giant hero headline, no decorative charts without labels, no repeated panels. App brand text "Adelpha", project "Twin magnet study", category "FEM", status "Simulation complete". A small discreet label states "CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA". Direction 01: PRECISION DESK. Dark graphite near-black background with subtle warm violet accents in keeping with Adelpha. A refined familiar engineering workbench: slim top app bar; left 210px project tree with assembly.step, Magnet 01, Magnet 02 and collapsed Setup/Mesh sections; huge central unobstructed 3D viewport taking 65% width; right 260px dedicated inspector holds all Field display controls neatly grouped with understated dividers. Top of viewport compact segmented CAD / Mesh / Results navigation. Right inspector shows B Flux density, Magnitude, Surfaces / Section, plane Y=0.00mm, display toggles, probe value 0.124 T. Bottom thin status strip and a compact color legend inside the viewport edge. No floating toolbar across the model. Visualize the two magnets with subtle triangle edges and a faint section plane. Premium calm, precise, cohesive; minimal borders; typography hierarchy. Small "01 / Precision Desk" concept title in bottom presentation strip.
